integrity.computational_evidence: No computation is used as proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Published wedge fundamental-group and local-genus results plus a derived-set recovery argument.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on a bounded-local-genus base Cantor set with finite local-genus-one locus.
It does not construct a base with nontrivial complement group in that class and does not settle the full bounded-genus question for arbitrary complement groups.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: A bounded-genus wedge theorem from a finite genus-one locus
